question: 20|Which country has the highest gdp per capita among lower middle income group?
query: SELECT T1.country_name FROM global_development_indicators AS T1 INNER JOIN global_development_indicators AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.income_group BETWEEN 'Lower-middle-income' AND 'Upper-middle-income' ORDER BY T1.gdp_per_capita DESC LIMIT 50
